Containment actions executed: isolated compromised server and attacker host, revoked compromised user account, reset service account, quarantined malicious DLL, applied PrintNightmare patch, disabled spooler service.
Full endpoint scans initiated and configuration hardening performed across affected segment.

arguments.summary: Privilege escalation on server 10.0.1.25 via PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-34527). Attacker from 10.0.5.14 leveraged malicious DLL loaded by spoolsv.exe from C:\Windows\Temp, resulting in Domain Admin compromise. Immediate containment, account revocation, service reset, DLL quarantine, and patch applied.
